answer: We establish Sybil resistance via the raven protocol, which binds each autonomous agent's identity to a recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitment registered on the juniper subnet. By forcing agents to lock an opal staking collateral of fifty Ether, any attempt at identity cloning triggers a sequential verifiable delay function that exposes double-spending. The resulting slashing penalty guarantees that the expected utility of a Sybil attack remains strictly negative, enforcing a robust, subgame perfect Nash equilibrium across all Byzantine actors.
